title.narrative: Réponse d'urgence intégrée en Eau, Hygiène et Assainissement (EHA), protection de l'enfance et Violence Basée sur le Genre (VBG) pour répondre aux besoins immédiats des enfants, des femmes et des personnes vulnérables - Personnes Déplacées Internes (PDI)

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide life-saving child protection assistance and water, sanitation and hygiene assistance to internally displaced persons, returnees, and host community members in Goma, Lubero, Rutshuru, and Nyiragongo. This UNICEF project implements case-area targeted interventions (CATI) to prevent the spread of cholera, facilitates water trucking, rehabilitates water points, distributes WASH kits, provides protection support to children (including family tracing, reunification, reintegration, case management services). The project water, sanitation and hygiene component provides humanitarian assistance to 151,000 people, including 32,000 women, 31,000 men, 88,000 children, and including 22,600 persons with disabilities. The project child protection component provides humanitarian assistance to 127,000 people, including 24,000 women, 23,000 men, 80,000 children, and including 20,000 persons with disabilities.
